label: US-Iran Peace Negotiations
value: No Formal Talks — Oman Hormuz Framework Accepted, Sanctions Escalating
source: NPR / CBS News / Al Jazeera / Oman Observer (Aug 7-29, 2026)
contestNote: The 60-day ceasefire fell apart July 8 after Iran struck commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz without US-framework clearance; Trump declared the deal 'over' at the NATO summit in Ankara. No formal US-Iran talks have resumed. Iran instead reached a near-final bilateral arrangement with Oman for jointly managing Hormuz shipping traffic that bars US and Israeli vessels, while conditioning any full reopening of the strait on the US lifting its naval blockade, withdrawing regional forces, and ending the war. On Aug 24 the US launched 'Operation Economic Outcast,' a 60+ target sanctions campaign, rather than resuming negotiations.
delta: IAEA Board of Governors voted 23-3 on Sep 9 to refer Iran's nuclear file to the UN Security Council for the first time in 20 years; Iran called the move 'completely counterproductive.' Pezeshkian and Putin jointly condemned Western sanctions at the Sep 11 BRICS Business Forum in New Delhi, with Pezeshkian saying pressure on Iran has entered a 'dangerous phase.'
deltaNote: Iranian officials say sanctions relief is 'desperately needed' as the blockade pushes the economy toward collapse, but Tehran maintains maximalist preconditions before engaging Washington directly. The UNSC referral is widely assessed as symbolic since Russia and China can veto new sanctions there.

label: Supreme Leader Public Status
value: Unconfirmed — No In-Person Appearance Since March; Written Message Marks War's 6-Month Mark
source: Anadolu Agency / The Week / Iran International / Al Jazeera / CBS News (Aug 8-30, 2026)
contestNote: Mojtaba Khamenei has made no confirmed public appearance since being named Supreme Leader in March 2026, following the Feb 28 strike that killed his father and reportedly injured him. Israeli media reported him in 'extremely critical condition' in early August; Iran's Mehr News released an undated 12-second video days later showing him with advisers, which resolved little given the lack of date/location markers. President Pezeshkian has said communication with him is 'very difficult.' Trump has claimed he is '90 percent gone.' On Aug 30, a written message attributed to Khamenei — marking six months since the war began — called on Muslim states to 'identify your real enemy'; it was text only, not video or audio.
delta: Aug 30 written message is the most recent proof-of-activity, but still no confirmed in-person appearance or verified voice/video recording since taking office

label: Executions in 2025 / 2026 YTD
source: Iran Human Rights (Oslo) / Human Rights Watch / Iran Human Rights Monitor (Sep 16, 2026)
contestNote: Iran's 2025 figure is the highest since 1981. Political executions have surged to levels unseen since the 1980s. HRW and the Abdorrahman Boroumand Center documented at least 59 men executed on political charges between March and August 2026, 29 tied to the December 2025-January 2026 protests. Iran Human Rights Monitor separately recorded 61 executions nationwide between Aug 23 and Sep 15 — roughly one every 9.6 hours. Actual totals are higher as the regime conceals execution data and issues no advance notification to families.
delta: Iran HRM documented 61 executions between Aug 23-Sep 15 (one every 9.6 hours); HRW/Boroumand Center reported 59 men executed on political charges since March, including teenagers, with 5 public hangings
deltaNote: Amnesty International's Sep 16 report on the 2022 'Woman, Life, Freedom' crackdown found the 2025-2026 crackdown bears the 'same hallmarks' but on 'an even deadlier and more staggering scale.' Judiciary began demolishing Gohardasht Prison (Karaj) Sep 13, part of a wider pattern of destroying evidence at detention and mass-grave sites.
